purpose: Define the validated development-time input schema for the T8 Decision Engine without creating a universal scalar target.

assignment_recommendation.native_semantics: IT Support category evidence plus retrieval/assignee evidence
allowed_evidence: T1 native decision evidence where available

overall_triage_recommendation.native_semantics: structured machine-generated synthesis of available task-specific evidence

T1.status: candidate evidence available; native model not formally frozen
T1.restriction: Do not silently promote a historical candidate model to frozen production status.

T3.restriction: Do not treat T3 as autonomous or authoritative severity.

T6.restriction: observable_non_positive is not a true negative.

T7.restriction: right censoring remains censoring; survival output is not converted into an ordinary regression target.

fusion_rules: Missing evidence means unavailable, not negative.
Do not assign arbitrary task weights.
Do not concatenate heterogeneous outputs blindly.
Do not construct a synthetic universal triage target.
Do not convert ranking outputs into probabilities without native justification.
Do not convert survival outputs into ordinary regression outputs.
Do not make causal claims from predictive evidence.
T6 observable_non_positive is not a true negative.
T7 censoring must remain explicitly represented.
